decisions.decision: Ignore the 2026-10-21T16:48 ripple note asking for PRs. That came from an Orchestrator decision made on 2026-10-18, and Adi's rule from 2026-10-11 overrides it: no writes to Usetantra repos. Build phase 1 as patches. Work in scratch copies of tantra-frontend-v2 and tantra-backend-v2 (git archive, no remote, as in T-152). Make five patches, each with its own test: (1) the Tantra centre page, (2) the sidebar item, (3) the gate exception, (4) the CSP change, (5) the shell fix. The shell fix reads GET /billing/me and treats a 404 as 'unknown'. Today /billing/me returns 404 and /api/v1/billing/me returns 401, so make the endpoint path a single constant. Also turn fix_pro-trial-days-7--SPEC.md into a real patch with a test. Check that every patch applies with git am and its test passes on a clean scratch copy. Add each patch and its apply steps to tantra-product-patches/README.md, and mark which parts are backend for Ben. Commit to the workshop repo, then move the task to review with Ben and Bharath.
decisions.why: The no-writes-to-usetantra-repos memory (Adi, 2026-10-11) is enforced by the git/gh guards. Spec section 11 Q2 and the T-448 log from 2026-10-21 already set the deliverable as patches. The 2026-10-18 PR approval conflicted with Adi's rule, and the Orchestrator cannot override his rules.
